sendToAI.promptPlaceholder: ¿Qué debe hacer la IA con esta captura? (p. ej. explicarla, resumirla, copiar el texto…)

explain.label: Explicar
explain.text: Look at this screenshot and explain it in plain language. Say what it is, what each main part is for, and anything important a non-expert should notice. If something is unclear in the image, say so instead of guessing.

summarize.label: Resumir
summarize.text: Summarize this screenshot in 3–5 short bullet points. Focus on the main message or task, not every tiny detail. Use simple words.

extractText.label: Extraer texto
extractText.text: Extract all readable text from this image. Preserve wording, line breaks, and order as closely as possible. If text is unreadable, mark it as [unclear].
